title: docs(adr-0135): on D6, an SSO link and a sign-in that would change an account's address follow the proven-domain rule
body:
## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:仅在 `docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md` 的 D6 下新增一条带日期的说明:开启 SSO 域名验证后,"已验证域名"规则除了管新建账号,也管隐式关联到已有账号,以及会改写已关联账号已存邮箱的登录(无法判定时也拒绝);不改写任何东西的登录与用户自己发起的显式关联不判定。D6 正文"已有账号不复查"一句加注例外并指向该说明;"本文件不新增条款"一句改为指向 D6 的两条说明。
- 为什么改:#33307 把同一条规则延伸到这两条路径,而 D6 原文写着"已有账号不复查"。授权来源是维护者 2026-11-14 的裁决(安全车道决策卡,选项 B「只拦会改邮箱的登录」,由 review#2 记录 6884303063 转述);记录 6880992920 是要求留下此说明的复核。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,不改代码、不发布;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md` 中 D6 末尾新增的 2026-11-14 说明。
- 两分钟验证:打开该文件搜索 "Note (2026-11-14",预期看到一段说明,写明链接与改邮箱登录按同一已验证域名规则判定。
- 需要你做的:以授权账号审批本 PR(Tier H 受管面 `docs/adr/**`);审批即确认 D6 记录该裁决的写法。请在 #33307 合并后再落地。

## What changes

`docs/adr/0135-identity-and-access-architecture.md`, D6 only:

- A dated note (2026-11-14). With SSO domain verification on, the proven-domain account rule also decides two more cases. An implicit link to an existing account is made only at a proven domain. A sign-in into an already-linked account is refused when it would change the stored address to one outside the proven domains, and refused where whether it would change the address cannot be determined.
- What the note leaves unjudged: a sign-in that changes nothing is admitted, and an explicit link is not judged.
- The rule's own refusal answers `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`; an input the gate cannot read is refused by the gate's general refusal.
- The authority is the maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-14, relayed in review record 6884303063. Record 6880992920 is cited as the review that required the note. #33307 implements the rule.
- In the D6 body, "Accounts that already exist are not re-checked" now names its two exceptions and points to the note.
- "What this record does NOT settle": the exception now points at the proven-domain account rule the D6 notes name, plural.

No code, no published package, so `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

- At `d2d02d8838`, the `dispatch-gates --commands` derivation for this diff (21 families), reconciled with `--ran`: 21 run, 0 not measured.

## Acceptance notes

- This is a governed surface (Tier H). It lands only after an authorized approval, and only after #33307 has merged. If #33307's head moves the rule again, re-read the note.
